title: Jetski Rentals Muskoka
specs: Largest Sea-Doo and Jet Ski rentals in Muskoka
Safety-first protocols with training and briefings
Boat license required to drive the vessel; temporary license issued if driver is present, 18 years old with valid G2 driver's license
All drivers must complete and sign safety checklist
No explicit age minimum stated beyond license requirements
Swimming ability not required but life jacket provided
includes: Gas and oil filled prior to rental
Life jacket, wetsuit, gloves, goggles available
gap: Exact age minimum beyond license requirements not stated
blurb: Guests rent jet skis and other watercraft for durations from 2 hours up to 7 days. Rentals include safety briefings and require a boat license or temporary license with conditions. Insurance and security deposits are mandatory.
extraNote: 25% rental deposit required with minimum $300 to reserve any watercraft · Security deposit of $3,000 required for all watercraft rentals · Insurance mandatory at $39 per calendar day · Cancellation over 30 days: $300 or 25% fee; under 30 days: credit valid for one year · Late fee $75 per half hour for late pick-up or drop-off · Watercraft must be returned with gas and oil as rented
